links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses (Flesch Kincaid Grade Level, Flesch Reading Ease) versus recommended reading level
links.effect: Mean FKGL 11.82 (SD 1.44) and mean FRE 38.60 (SD 9.00); outputs exceeded average US reading level, limiting accessibility.
links.quote: Readability analysis showed outputs exceeded the average US reading level (mean Flesch Kincaid Grade Level 11.82, SD 1.44; mean FRE 38.60, SD 9.00), limiting accessibility.

links.outcome: Reading level of chatbot health information relative to recommended level
links.effect: Outputs written above recommended reading level for health information; mean FKGL 11.82, FRE 38.60.
links.quote: AI chatbots can provide moderately accurate and supportive responses to needs of AYA patients with melanoma, but outputs are inconsistent, written above the recommended reading level for health information, and limited in empathy.

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality, empathy, and readability of responses from commercial LLM chatbots (ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini) to patient-derived questions regarding melanoma survivorship needs without testing a deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
